title: An improved volume bound under Ricci and scalar curvature lower bounds
summary: We study volume comparison for closed Riemannian manifolds satisfying a positive Ricci curvature lower bound together with an improved scalar curvature lower bound. We prove that if a closed Riemannian manifold $(N^n, g)$ satisfies $\operatorname{Ric}_g\ge (n-1)g$ and the scalar curvature $R_g\ge n(n-1)(1+\varepsilon)$, then its volume satisfies $$\lvert N\rvert_g \le \frac{1}{\sqrt{1+n\varepsilon}}\lvert\mathbb S^n\rvert. $$ In fact, assuming only $\mathrm{Ric}_g\ge(n-1)g$, we can prove that $$\frac{|N|_g}{\left|\mathbb{S}^n\right|} \le \frac{1}{|N|_g}…
